description: Read notes on a verse -- Translation Notes, Matthew Henry, Calvin, and similar. Use this for "what does Matthew Henry say" or "notes on John 3:16". Returns matching notes, or none if there are not any. For the Bible text itself, use read.

book.description: Bible book, like John or JHN

end.description: Last verse to include, same book. Leave off to read just the starting verse

resource.description: Which notes, like en_tn (Translation Notes) or en_mhc (Matthew Henry). Not a Bible id

verse.description: Starting verse. Use 1 if you only know the chapter

name: read_commentary
